subject: Error in nrow(SNPs2) : object 'SNPs2' not found

messages.author: 1cfe89227e37a1d3
messages.subject: Error in nrow(SNPs2) : object 'SNPs2' not found
parts:
Hello All,

I am encountering an issue using userGWAS function for GWAS-by-subtraction with SNP. 

The code is shown as below:
outputGWAS_snp<-userGWAS(covstruc=LDSCoutput, SNPs=p_sumstats, estimation="DWLS", model=model_snp, sub =c("PS~SNP","MD~SNP"))

However, I'm getting an error where it says:
Error in nrow(SNPs2) : object 'SNPs2' not found

Does anyone have insight into how to fix this error? I saw an earlier thread on the same issue but specifying the number of cores (as the solution for the previous thread) could not fix my error.

Thank you!
Regards,
Matthew
